notes: Only assigned unfinished fields checked. Other fields/sides are placeholders. Source is the primary authors’ SCR Final.xlsx table, sheet Study overviews and small teles, supplied as canonical text; paper-page locators cannot be resolved in this table. No supplied PDF. Targets matched using author/study and substantive IV/DV/contrast descriptions, never input order or numeric agreement. No conversions or p calculations. es_value_r: Kristofferson Study 5 row identifies the 2x2 design, but M=F(1, 385) = 0.005 and O=r = 0.003603726 are not labelled as a model term or simple/planned contrast. The requested specific contrast cannot be linked to that statistic. No simple-contrast d or labelled contrast test is printed; omnibus candidate retained without assignment. pval_value_r: Inspected this study’s replication result/effect columns and table headers (row 2). The source prints test statistics and/or r with 95% confidence intervals, but no same-test p-value or p bound. No p-value calculated. reported_success: Inspected the study entry and replication-result/effect columns. These give numerical tests, effect estimates and confidence intervals (or raw/cleaned labels), but no authors’ narrative replication-success verdict. A verdict cannot be inferred from the statistic or confidence interval.
